systems.owner: Agence Nationale d'Identification des Personnes (ANIP), under the President of the Republic; resources include annual State allocations under the Finance Law, development-partner funds and authentication and document fees, with an initial allocation of 250 million FCFA
systems.tiers: National; ANIP has departmental delegations at the prefectures (DDIP) and a communal unit for the identification of persons (UCIP) at each town hall
ANIP's information systems directorate contributes to its updating

note: The decree organising ANIP: it gives the agency the population register, the communal registers of persons and the identification number, and mentions the central civil-status file only as something its IT directorate helps update; nothing on how a birth or death is registered.
